scope_note: Released feature-film acting appearances through 13 September 2026 (260 films), including cameos, guest and special appearances, self appearances, narration and voice roles, and films in Bhojpuri, English, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu and Tulu. The bilingual Barsaat Ki Ek Raat and its Bengali version Anusandhan (1981) share one row. Excluded: the unreleased Zamaanat and Kalki 2898 AD – Part 2; Section 84, not released by the cutoff; the short film Power (2012); Bunty Aur Babli 2 (2021), which uses archival footage only; Veergatha (2016), an audiovisual with no evidence of a theatrical feature release; documentaries (the Hindi narration of March of the Penguins, The Story of Film: An Odyssey, Bollywood: The Greatest Love Story Ever Told, The Journey of India, The Romantics, Angry Young Men, Naam Tha Kanhaiyalal and The Real Superstar); television; music videos; and producer-only credits. Release dates are Indian theatrical dates where the film article gives them, otherwise the year. Box-office figures without a nett/gross label are kept in research notes rather than money columns. Nine films have no Wikipedia article and rest on IMDb listings or on newspaper citations in the Wikipedia filmography.
